name: Malis Cambodian Restaurant
address: No. 136 Norodom Blvd, Tonle Bassac, Phnom Penh
description: Celebrated for reviving traditional 'Living Cambodian Cuisine' in a serene tropical courtyard with a Buddha pond. Famous for Kampot pepper crab, fish amok, and morning kuy teav.

reviews.author: Sokha Meas
reviews.text: The Saraman beef and Kampot crab are unmatched. Peaceful garden ambiance right in the city center.

reviews.author: David Chen
reviews.text: Best introduction to authentic Khmer gastronomy. Impeccable service.

name: Angkor Wat Archaeological Park
address: Krong Siem Reap, Siem Reap Province
description: The largest religious monument in the world and the crown jewel of the Khmer Empire. Arrive before dawn to watch the sun rise behind the iconic five lotus-bud towers.

reviews.author: Elena Rostova
reviews.text: Breathtaking at sunrise. Hire a licensed local guide at the entrance to understand the bas-relief stories.

reviews.author: Bopha Chann
reviews.text: No matter how many times you visit, the scale and craftsmanship leave you speechless.

name: Amber Kampot
description: An intimate all-pool-suite sanctuary nestled along the tranquil Kampot River, offering private plunge pools, spa treatments, and panoramic views of Bokor Mountain.

reviews.author: Marcus Vance
reviews.text: Watching sunset over Bokor Mountain from the infinity pool was the highlight of our trip.

name: Brown Coffee Roastery (BKK1)
address: Street 57 & 294, Boeung Keng Kang 1, Phnom Penh
description: Cambodia's beloved homegrown specialty coffee house combining warm Khmer architectural brickwork with locally roasted beans, freshly baked croissants, and fast Wi-Fi.

reviews.author: Vannak Lim
reviews.text: Palm Sugar Iced Latte is a must-try! Great power outlets and calm atmosphere for remote work.

name: Shinta Mani Angkor
address: Junction of Oum Khun & 14th Street, Siem Reap
description: Designed by acclaimed architect Bill Bensley in the leafy French Quarter, blending monochrome Khmer-inspired elegance with a social enterprise mission supporting local communities.

reviews.author: Claire Dupont
reviews.text: Every corner looks like an art gallery. Just a 5-minute walk to the Old Market and river.

name: Twenty Three Bistro
description: Intimate bistro set in a restored French colonial shophouse celebrating fresh Kep seafood, organic Kampot green peppercorns, and craft botanical cocktails.

reviews.author: Liam O'Connor
reviews.text: Book ahead! The seared tuna with green Kampot peppercorn sauce was unforgettable.

name: Royal Palace & Silver Pagoda
address: Samdach Sothearos Blvd, Daun Penh, Phnom Penh
description: The official residence of the King of Cambodia, showcasing classic Khmer gilded roofs, manicured gardens, and the Silver Pagoda floored with over 5,000 silver tiles.

reviews.author: Sreyneath Keo
reviews.text: Remember to dress modestly covering shoulders and knees. Stunning golden spires in the afternoon light.

name: The Little Red Fox Espresso
address: Hap Guan Street, Kandal Village, Siem Reap
description: A vibrant creative hub in trendy Kandal Village serving ethically sourced Cambodian & regional specialty coffee, cold brew tonics, and nourishing brunch bowls.

reviews.author: Hannah Brooks
reviews.text: Best flat white in Siem Reap and right next to great independent boutiques.
